	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	saved_scopes = { ucm_crozier_cheats_char }
	effect = { ucm_crozier_cheats_toast = { KEY = t_schemes_expose } scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { every_scheme = { limit = { is_scheme_exposed = no } expose_scheme = yes } } }
}

ucm_crozier_cheats_sg_t_t_schemes_end = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	saved_scopes = { ucm_crozier_cheats_char }
	effect = { ucm_crozier_cheats_toast = { KEY = t_schemes_end } scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { every_scheme = { end_scheme = yes } } }
}

ucm_crozier_cheats_sg_t_t_child_me = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	saved_scopes = { ucm_crozier_cheats_char }
	is_valid = { NOT = { scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { this = root } } }
	effect = { ucm_crozier_cheats_toast = { KEY = t_child_me } if = { limit = { scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { is_female = yes is_pregnant = no } is_female = no } scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { make_pregnant = { father = root } } } else_if = { limit = { is_female = yes is_pregnant = no scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { is_female = no } } make_pregnant = { father = scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char } } }
}

ucm_crozier_cheats_sg_t_t_child_now = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	saved_scopes = { ucm_crozier_cheats_char }
	is_valid = { OR = { AND = { scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { is_female = yes } root = { is_female = no } } AND = { scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { is_female = no } root = { is_female = yes } } } }
	effect = { ucm_crozier_cheats_toast = { KEY = t_child_now } if = { limit = { is_female = yes } create_character = { mother = root father = scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char age = 0 employer = root dynasty = inherit ethnicity = parents gender_female_chance = 50 trait = intellect_good_3 trait = physique_good_3 trait = beauty_good_3 } } else = { create_character = { mother = scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char father = root age = 0 employer = root dynasty = inherit ethnicity = parents gender_female_chance = 50 trait = intellect_good_3 trait = physique_good_3 trait = beauty_good_3 } } }
}

ucm_crozier_cheats_sg_t_t_guest = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	saved_scopes = { ucm_crozier_cheats_char }
	is_valid = { scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { is_ruler = no NOT = { employer ?= root } } }
	effect = { ucm_crozier_cheats_toast = { KEY = t_guest } scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { visit_court_of = root } }
}

ucm_crozier_cheats_sg_t_t_hostage = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	saved_scopes = { ucm_crozier_cheats_char }
	is_valid = { scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { is_hostage = no is_ruler = no } }
	effect = { ucm_crozier_cheats_toast = { KEY = t_hostage } take_hostage = scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char }
}

ucm_crozier_cheats_sg_t_t_hostage_free = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	saved_scopes = { ucm_crozier_cheats_char }
	is_valid = { scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { is_hostage = yes } }
	effect = { ucm_crozier_cheats_toast = { KEY = t_hostage_free } scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { return_hostage = yes } }
}

ucm_crozier_cheats_sg_t_t_family_hostages = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	saved_scopes = { ucm_crozier_cheats_char }
	effect = { ucm_crozier_cheats_toast = { KEY = t_family_hostages } scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { every_child = { limit = { is_hostage = no is_ruler = no is_alive = yes } save_temporary_scope_as = ucm_crozier_cheats_kid root = { take_hostage = scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_kid } } } }
}

ucm_crozier_cheats_sg_t_t_armies_to = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	saved_scopes = { ucm_crozier_cheats_char }
	is_valid = { scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { exists = capital_province } }
	effect = { ucm_crozier_cheats_toast = { KEY = t_armies_to } every_army = { limit = { is_army_in_combat = no } set_army_location = scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char.capital_province } }
}

ucm_crozier_cheats_sg_t_enemy_deplete = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	saved_scopes = { ucm_crozier_cheats_char }
	effect = { ucm_crozier_cheats_toast = { KEY = enemy_deplete } if = { limit = { global_var:ucm_crozier_cheats_tier ?= 1 } ucm_crozier_cheats_deplete_target = { SHARE = 0.25 } } else_if = { limit = { global_var:ucm_crozier_cheats_tier ?= 3 } ucm_crozier_cheats_deplete_target = { SHARE = 0.9 } } else = { ucm_crozier_cheats_deplete_target = { SHARE = 0.5 } } }
}

	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	saved_scopes = { ucm_crozier_cheats_char }
	is_valid = { scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { is_landed = yes exists = capital_province } }
	effect = { ucm_crozier_cheats_toast = { KEY = t_epidemic_bubonic_plague } scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char.capital_province = { create_epidemic_outbreak = { type = bubonic_plague intensity = major } } }
}

	is_shown = { ucm_single_player_trigger = yes }
	saved_scopes = { ucm_crozier_cheats_char }
	is_valid = { scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char = { OR = { employer ?= root is_vassal_of = root } is_adult = yes } }
	effect = { ucm_crozier_cheats_toast = { KEY = t_councillor_chancellor } assign_councillor_type = { type = councillor_chancellor target = scope:ucm_crozier_cheats_char remove_existing_councillor = yes } }
}
